title: 公开建筑回放 01
description: BDG2公开建筑电表与站点天气，仅支持异常候选筛查，无真实设备故障标签。

perturbation.description: 无额外人为扰动；保留原始缺测。

baseline_method: Past 4 weeks median for matching weekday/hour; descriptive reference, not a calibrated prediction interval.
evidence_scope: Measured meter and weather replay only; no equipment point linkage to LBNL.
attribution: Miller et al. (2020), Building Data Genome Project 2, DOI 10.1038/s41597-020-00712-x; CC BY-SA 4.0.
